title: An-Naba' as a whole: meaning and tadabbur: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: An-Naba' and Al-Qadr as a model
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 45 (Pupil PDF worksheet: An-Naba' as a whole rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 45. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Ayat
Theme
rows: Signs in creation: the One who made this can raise the dead
The Day of Judgement and the punishment of transgressors
The reward of the righteous; the Day of truth; the choice

panels.title: An argument from creation
points: Allah made the earth, mountains, sleep, night and day
He brings dead land to life with rain
So raising people again is easy for Him

questions.a: Sleep is rest from Allah; action: sleep on time, say the sleeping du'a and wake for Fajr.

questions.q: Tadabbur (portal response box): choose one ayah of An-Naba'; write what it tells you and one action, using the steps. Today's rota group recites An-Naba' whole.
questions.a: A short reflection with the ayah cited and a realistic action.

questions.q: Extend: draw the surah's structure as a flow diagram (no living beings).
How do 78:6 to 16 answer people who doubt the Resurrection?
options: The One who created all this can easily recreate
They tell a story of a prophet
questions.a: A) The One who created all this can easily recreate. Signs in creation point to Allah's power to resurrect.
the reward and the Day of truth
options: the reward and the Day of truth

questions.q: Think again: An-Naba' starts with people asking questions and ends with a person full of regret. What happens in between to change everything?
questions.a: Allah shows His signs, describes the Day of Judgement, its punishment and reward, and calls us to choose the way back to Him.
